objective: Determine whether the frozen M473 exact parent-result reuse can use nine generated 128x128b 1RW single-port macros with an executable deadline-lookahead schedule and at most five percent cycle overhead.

runtime_failures_found_before_citation: Resolve the command-line contract path before computing its repository-relative identity.
Use Python False rather than the undefined lowercase name false in claim-boundary serialization.
Rename result and CSV artifacts from stale r1 suffixes to r3.

frozen_coordinate.arithmetic: Exact signed12 parent/residual reconstruction and signed19 resident psum; no checkpoint or accuracy change.

single_port_schedule.macro_rule: At most one 1152-bit scratch read or one 1152-bit scratch write per cycle.
single_port_schedule.issue_order: Ascending original popcount then ascending row index, identical to M473.
single_port_schedule.parent_edge_order: Prefetch in future consumer order into the existing two-entry FIFO; every parent edge remains independent.
single_port_schedule.producer_validity: Read only after the topologically prior producer row completed and wrote scratch.
single_port_schedule.response_latency: A read accepted in t returns at the t+1 edge and cannot satisfy issue at the start of t+1.
single_port_schedule.capacity: Reserve queue occupancy plus one pending synchronous response; never use same-cycle consume credit.
single_port_schedule.forwarding: Forward a current final write to the next unmet same-row parent edge when queue plus pending is below two.
single_port_schedule.deadline_lookahead_admission_policy: Hold a ready current final issue for one cycle only when the immediately next active row has an unmet, already-written, non-forwardable parent and queue plus pending is below two; launch that parent read during the hold.
single_port_schedule.rtl_lookahead_obligation: Include one registered next-active descriptor parent_valid/id, compare, hold control and payload-stability logic in matched DC.
single_port_schedule.optimality_boundary: Executable but not globally optimal; compare only deterministic small tasks against the embedded BFS oracle.

cycle_model.pipeline_equation: M473 selected-coordinate pipeline; replace only eight times per-task product issue window.

macro_model.dual_port_overdepth_proxy: 16 x foundry-QRT DP 128x72m4f using lower 64 rows
macro_model.dual_port_preferred: 16 x compiler-legal DP 64x72m4f; no generated or QRT PPA view exists
macro_model.single_port_generated: 9 x generated TS1N28HPCPHVTB128X128M4S using lower 64 rows and 1152/1152 bits
macro_model.boundary: DP values are QRT fallback/proxy; SP is a generated over-depth mapping. Preferred DP and integrated macro PPA remain open.

materiality_gates.rtl_rule: All four gates plus an independent r3 result hammer must pass before RTL is authorized.

fail_closed: Abort on any frozen SHA, task-order or M473 anchor drift.
Abort on read-before-producer, simultaneous single-port read/write, dropped edge or FIFO reorder.
Abort if reconstructed ideal 1R1W cycles differ from 389974420.
Never claim global optimality or substitute either DP proxy for preferred DP PPA.
Never label a passing audit RTL, Synopsys, integrated PPA, system speedup or DATE headline evidence.
